messages:
Ella: Quick poll: should we officially name the office ficus? Current contenders: Mr. Whiskers, Leafy McLeafface, or The Cache?
Ravi: Mr. Whiskers forever. It looks like a Mr. Whiskers. :seedling::smile:
June: The Cache is my vote. It silently stores energy and occasionally drops leaves like garbage-collected objects.
Ben: Leafy McLeafface is peak internet culture, but Mr. Whiskers has dignity.
Maya: FacilitiesBot: reminder: plants in common areas are cared for by facilities. Please do not re-pot without asking.
Ella: Noted. This is a naming vote only. No re-potting rebellions.
Ravi: I propose a small plaque: "Mr. Whiskers, Chief Morale Officer". Who's in?
June: In. Also propose ritual: every Friday someone waters and takes a selfie with Mr. Whiskers.
Ben: Selfie tradition approved. We'll call it Friday Ficus Faces. :camera_with_flash:
Maya: CultureOps: if this becomes a weekly micro-ritual, we can add it to Slack reminders. Low overhead, high culture points.
Ella: Vote tally so far: Mr. Whiskers 2, The Cache 1, Leafy McLeafface 1. More votes?
Ravi: Can we have honorary titles for interns? Like "Leaf Wrangler in Training"?
June: Yes, interns shall be indoctrinated into the watering rota. Gentle warning: do not overwater.
Ben: Remember last year's "we turned the ficus into a moss terrarium" incident. Never forget.
Ella: Proposal: Mr. Whiskers coronation this Friday at 3pm. Short speech, plaque unveiling, one tasteful confetti popper (optional).
Maya: FacilitiesBot: approved small non-mess confetti. Please clean up after.
Ravi: I'll craft a tiny sash. Ben will take selfies. June will write a haiku for the unveiling.
June: Haiku draft: "Quiet green sentinel / Holds the meeting-room secrets / Leaves applaud in wind"
Ben: That's actually beautiful and also a little dramatic for a plant. Love it.
FacilitiesBot: FYI: weekly plant care sign-up created at /forms/plant-care. Please sign up if you'll be near the ficus on Fridays.
Ella: OK team, final vote: Mr. Whiskers wins by consensus. Planning coronation Friday 15:00 in conf room B. Bring small celebratory vibes.
Ravi: Long live Mr. Whiskers. May his leaves never yellow. :crown::seedling:
Maya: I'll set a Slack reminder and drop a calendar invite. CultureOps will add a micro ritual to the handbook.
Ben: Photo op mandatory. I'll prepare an album called "Office Flora Legends".
June: We will need to enforce a strict "no glitter" policy. Learned that one the hard way.
CultureOps: Noted. We'll supply napkins and eco-friendly confetti. Congrats Mr. Whiskers, Keeper of Meeting Energy.
Ella: See you Friday. If anyone has alternate name regrets, now is the time to whisper them to their coffee.
Ravi: Whispering to coffee now.
